meta.title: Wetherspoons Stoke-on-Trent: Pubs, menu and prices guide
meta.description: Find Wetherspoons Stoke-on-Trent pubs across {areaCount} areas, compare local menu prices and check breakfast and club days before choosing where to go.

intro:
This guide covers {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Stoke-on-Trent across {areaCount} areas, helping you choose a pub and plan what to order. Every pub works from the national [Wetherspoons menu](/), but prices are set locally. Find the pub names and locations below, alongside practical guidance on typical menu prices, breakfast service and club days.

The national menu provides a useful starting point, but prices are set by each pub. SpoonsMenu is an independent guide, not affiliated with J D Wetherspoon plc, so check your chosen pub’s menu before ordering.
quickAnswer: Our Stoke-on-Trent guide lists {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs across {areaCount} areas: The Reginald Mitchell in Hanley, The Bradley Green in Biddulph, The Wheatsheaf in Stoke and The Arnold Machin in Newcastle-under-Lyme. Choose the area that suits your plans, then check that pub’s menu for current dishes and typical prices rather than assuming every location charges the same.

areas.text: The Reginald Mitchell is the listed Wetherspoons pub in Hanley, on Parliament Row. It suits anyone looking for a Wetherspoons meal in this area. Use its own menu to compare your options, as the broadly national food range does not mean identical prices between pubs.

The Bradley Green is the listed Wetherspoons pub in Biddulph, on High Street. Choose it if Biddulph fits your plans rather than travelling to another listed area. Check the pub’s menu before settling on breakfast, a burger or another national menu option.

The Wheatsheaf is the listed Wetherspoons pub in Stoke, on Church Street. It is an option for visitors who want to eat in Stoke itself. Look at the local menu for current dishes and typical prices, particularly if you are comparing it with another pub.

The Arnold Machin is the listed Wetherspoons pub in Newcastle-under-Lyme, on Ironmarket. It suits visitors whose plans take them to this area. Before choosing what to order, check its menu rather than relying on a price seen at a different Wetherspoons pub.

pricing:
Wetherspoons menu prices in Stoke-on-Trent are set pub by pub, even though the food menu is broadly the same nationally. Traditional [breakfast](/breakfast-menu), [burgers](/burgers), curries, fish and chips, and pizza are popular national menu choices, but check your chosen pub’s menu for its current selection and typical prices.

City centre pubs often charge more than suburban pubs, so location can matter when comparing costs. That general pattern does not establish which of these listed pubs is cheapest.

For the exact price of your intended order, consult the menu at the pub or check it when ordering through the Wetherspoon app. Compare the same dish at each location rather than assuming a national menu means a national price.
breakfastAndClubs:
Wetherspoons breakfast is typically served from eight am until midday, while [Curry Club](/curry-club) is traditionally on Thursday and [Steak Club](/steak-club) on Tuesday at participating pubs. For a Stoke-on-Trent visit, treat those as general timings and days, not confirmation for every listed location.

Check [breakfast](/breakfast-menu) service with your chosen pub before planning an early meal. Traditional breakfast is a popular national menu option, but the local menu is the place to confirm your order and typical price. If a club day is your reason for visiting, ask the pub whether it participates before making plans.
